name: goodmem
label: GoodMem
description: Store documents as memories with vector embeddings and perform similarity-based semantic retrieval using GoodMem

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.description: The base URL of your GoodMem API server (e.g., https://api.goodmem.ai or http://localhost:8080). The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Your GoodMem API key for authentication (X-API-Key)

create_memory.label: Create Memory
create_memory.description: Store a document as a new memory in a space. The memory is processed asynchronously - chunked into searchable pieces and embedded into vectors. Accepts a file or plain text.

file.label: File
file.description: A file to store as memory (PDF, DOCX, image, etc.). Connect the output of a trigger or action that provides a file. Content type is auto-detected from the file extension.

textContent.label: Text Content
textContent.description: Plain text content to store as memory (sent as text/plain). If both File and Text Content are provided, the file takes priority.

source.label: Source
source.description: Where this memory came from (e.g., "google-drive", "gmail", "manual upload"). Stored in metadata.source

author.label: Author
author.description: The author or creator of the content. Stored in metadata.author

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Comma-separated tags for categorization (e.g., "legal,research,important"). Stored in metadata.tags as an array

metadata.label: Additional Metadata
metadata.description: Extra key-value metadata as JSON. Merged with Source, Author, and Tags fields above

ai_store_memory.label: Store Memory
ai_store_memory.description: Store text as a new memory in a space.

spaceId.label: Space ID
spaceId.description: The ID of the space to store the memory in

source.label: Source
source.description: Where the content came from, stored in metadata.source

author.label: Author
author.description: Author of the content, stored in metadata.author

metadata.label: Additional Metadata
metadata.description: Extra key-value metadata as a JSON object
